description: Defines classes and enums for managing cache rankings and LRU lists in disk cache, including Rankings class, List enum, and ScopedRankingsBlock helper.

classes.name: Rankings
classes.description: Manages cache ranking information, including insertion, removal, and iteration over cache entries.

classes.name: Rankings::ScopedRankingsBlock
classes.description: A specialized unique_ptr for CacheRankingsBlock that calls FreeRankingsBlock on deletion.

classes.name: Rankings::Iterator
classes.description: Tracks current position during iteration over multiple cache lists.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Rankings object with backend and list counting options.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Restores the Rankings object to its initial state.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a cache entry into a specified list.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry from a specified list.

methods.name: UpdateRank
methods.description: Moves a cache entry to the head of a list.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Returns the next node in a list.

methods.name: GetPrev
methods.description: Returns the previous node in a list.

methods.name: TrackRankingsBlock
methods.description: Starts or stops tracking a node for enumeration.
